messages:
maria: Starting handoff for VIP customer 'Aurelia' — full launch + load test tomorrow 00:00 UTC. Peak expected ~6k rps. Quick summary of risks:
- HPA/scale-up lag because KV cache cold -> higher tail latency.
- Dedicated GPU pool could hit burst cap if batch sizes spike.
- TLS cert on LB expires 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (certs team looped).
- Contract throttle: soft limit at 5M tokens/day may trigger billing throttle.

maria: Runbook quick checks (run now if you haven't):
```bash
# HPA / scaling
kubectl -n inference get hpa
# recent request rate
curl -sS 'https://metrics.prod/redwood/api/v1/query?query=avg_over_time(requests[5m])'
# cert check
gcloud compute ssl-certificates list --filter='name:vip-aurelia'
```

maria: Current rollout state: canary 10% -> planned ramp to 100% over 3h if error rate < 0.5%. Cache warm-up job queued (job id 4382). If p50/p95 latency > 300ms for 10m, rollback to model-quant2 and open incident. Ping @alex for autoscaler issues.

alex: Ack. I'll watch HPA and GPU pool during the window. Pre-seeding KV keys in warmup script now (job 4382 logs -> https://console.prod/jobs/4382/logs). I also filed GPU quota bump earlier today — should be provisioned. Setting alert: GPU_UTIL >85% for 3m. :eyes:

raj: I'll take the overnight watch (00:00-08:00 UTC). If we see persistent 503s run this local failover and page: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/failover --pool dedicated`
Also added temporary log filter for quick triage: `severity:ERROR AND service:inference`. If downstream DB errors spike, escalate to infra.

sophie: Noted on throttle risk. I emailed sales/finance with the potential overage scenario and approval path. If we need to bump the contract tier during the window, I'll coordinate immediate approval.

maria: Thanks. Small ops notes: please don't run full GC on the cache hosts during warmup. If you need to test, use the staging pool. Also be careful with manual model rollouts — prefer canary increments of 10%.

maria: @oncall-bot schedule a rotation reminder at 2026-03-17 23:45 UTC with note: "Aurelia launch watch — raj primary, alex backup"

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-17 23:45 UTC. Rotation: raj primary, alex backup.

alex: Quick heads up — warmup job logs show some `WARN: kv-miss` spikes at start for certain prefixes, that's expected. :white_check_mark:

raj: Acknowledged. I'll join the watch channel 15m early to grab context. If any SLO breaches, I'll page per runbook and log actions in the incident channel.

sophie: FYI I've attached the customer escalation contacts in the shared doc (link: https://drive.prod/redwood/aurelia-escalation).

maria: All good. Thanks team — leave any post-handoff notes here.
